_doc: Seconds per test on a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner, for tests/conftest.py's topic-coherent, duration-balanced CI shards. 'tests': the exact setup + call + teardown of every test a full CI run's --durations report listed (>= 0.5 s; run 37900825561, 2026-10-09: 760 tests, 8.88 h in all; the old plan's 20 job times re-predicted from them within a minute but the host job). 'files': the seconds of a test the report did NOT list -- 0.05, measured on that run's host job. A test of a file in neither: 'default_fj' / 'default_host'. Refresh after a full CI run: python scripts/ci_durations.py <run id>.
